AgentWarmup schedules guarded local CLI requests through the user's operating-system scheduler. Predicted times are target resets; a successful request does not verify a reset.

This candidate is for deliberate fake-provider and clean-machine acceptance testing. Codex and Claude reset validation remains pending. No provider or platform compatibility is advertised by the presence of a build artifact.

Archives include one executable and the MIT license. Verify the archive against checksums.txt before running it. Release-attached installers resolve the assets of this exact release. The npm tarball embeds this release's executable hashes; its launcher requires Node 22 or later. Native installation requires no language runtime. Provider CLIs remain prerequisites.

Setup offers arrow-key choices for providers, reset time, and days, with plain prompts available. The installed executable runs the schedule independently of npm. The attached npm tarball is a packaging artifact; its presence does not mean the package has been published to the registry.

Rerun the installer to update while preserving settings. Manage the application with setup, pause, resume, and uninstall. Keep the computer awake, online, and logged in. Requests consume allowance, cannot force an active window to move, and are skipped more than two minutes late.

Signing/notarization and clean-machine trust prompts are pending acceptance. Review docs/validation.md and docs/pre-publish.md before promoting a candidate.
